purpose: Place an action after a completed event.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
た-form + 後で; noun + の後で.
I will take a walk after lunch.
Let us talk briefly after the meeting.
I played a game after finishing my homework.
formation: た-form + 後で; noun + の後で.
restrictions: The first event is treated as completed before the main event.
mistake: Use 食べた後で, not 食べる後で.
